epic.title: Route Planning & Infrastructure Management
epic.body: Handles the end-to-end configuration of transport logistics, including route definition, stop sequence mapping, vehicle assignments, and driver allocations to ensure efficient and safe student transit.

features.title: Route & Stop Management
features.body: Define and manage the physical routes, including geographic paths and the sequence of pickup/drop-off points with associated timings.

stories.title: Route Definition and Management Interface
stories.body: As a transport manager, I want to create, list, update, and delete routes so that I can maintain an organized transport network.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Display all routes with Name, Total Stops, and Assigned Vehicle.
Create: Form to add Route Name, Description, and Start/End points.
Update: Modify existing route details and geographic metadata.
Delete: Remove routes with a dependency check for active student assignments.

stories.title: Interactive Stop Sequence Configuration
stories.body: Manage the list of stops within a route, defining their order and estimated arrival times.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Show all stops for a selected route in a drag-and-drop or ordered list.
Create: Add new stops with specific geographic coordinates and a 'Pickup Time'.
Update: Change the sequence order or timing for specific stops.
Delete: Remove individual stops from a route.

stories.title: Transport Routing Data Service
stories.body: Backend API to persist route structures, stop sequences, and spatial data.
acceptanceCriteria: POST/PUT: Save route objects including nested arrays of stop metadata (latitude, longitude, time).
GET: Retrieve optimized route lists for specific branches or organizations.
DELETE: Clean up route records and associated student mappings.

features.title: Student-to-Route Enrollment
features.body: Handles the assignment of students to specific routes and stops based on their residential locations.

stories.title: Manage Student Transport Assignments
stories.body: As a transport manager, I want to list and manage student allocations for each route stop.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Search and filter students by name, class, or route stop.
Update: Assign or change a student's pickup/drop-off stop.
Summary: View total student count per route against vehicle capacity.

stories.title: Student Transport Mapping Service
stories.body: API to manage the persistence of student-route relationships and pickup/drop-off schedules.
acceptanceCriteria: POST: Create enrollment records linking studentId to stopId and routeId.
GET: Retrieve student lists per route for driver manifest generation.
